fixed: Saving an edit while Device Sync is bringing in changes from another device waits less on a large collection: sync no longer reads your whole collection a second time, just to check for edits you made, before applying.

changed: `SyncApplyConcurrencyStorage.snapshotCandidates()` is replaced by `currentCandidates(addresses)`, which reads only the records an inbound batch touches instead of the whole library.
added: `DanceRepository.getByIds` and `ProgramRepository.getByIds` read a set of records in batched queries, hydrated as `listAll` hydrates them.
